tours.title: Algeria Cultural Tour — 5 Days
tours.summary: Five days across the heart of Algeria — the UNESCO Casbah of Algiers, the Roman coast at Tipaza, and the timeless M'Zab Valley on the edge of the Sahara, with a private licensed guide throughout.

tours.title: Djanet Sahara Safari — 5-Day Tadrart Rouge
tours.summary: Five days deep in the Algerian Sahara around Djanet — the red sandstone of the Tadrart, golden dunes, prehistoric rock art, and nights under the stars with a local Tuareg team.
tours.hook: Five days in the most beautiful desert on Earth — blood-red sandstone, golden dunes and 10,000-year-old art, guided by the Tuareg who have always called it home.
tours.overview: The Tadrart Rouge is not the Sahara of postcards. It is a sunken cathedral of red sandstone — arches, towers and canyons carved by wind over millions of years, set against dunes so fine they pour like water. For five days you travel deep into Algeria's far south by 4×4, sleep in desert camps beneath a sky thick with stars, and walk among rock paintings made when this desert was green savanna. There are no crowds, no fences, no souvenir stalls — only the silence of the Sahara and a small Tuareg team who know every dune and spring by name.

whyDifferent.t: The desert most travellers never reach
whyDifferent.d: Djanet sits 2,000 km south of Algiers; the reward for the distance is a landscape that feels untouched.

whyDifferent.t: You travel with Tuareg, not tour buses
whyDifferent.d: Your guide and driver are local Tuareg; tea is brewed on the sand and navigation is by memory.

whyDifferent.t: Nights that ruin every other night sky
whyDifferent.d: Zero light pollution — the Milky Way casts shadows. You sleep in open desert camps, not hotels.
The rock art of Tassili n'Ajjer records a green Sahara of giraffes, cattle and dancers.

tours.title: Ghardaïa — 3-Day M'Zab Valley Tour
tours.summary: Three days in the M'Zab Valley — the fortified hill-towns of Ghardaïa and Beni Isguen, the ancient foggara water system, palm oases, and a 4×4 desert evening under the stars.
tours.hook: Three days in the M'Zab — the thousand-year-old hill-towns of the Mozabites, their secret water channels, and a night in the open desert.
tours.overview: The M'Zab Valley is one of the most extraordinary places in the Sahara: five fortified towns built by the Ibadi Mozabites from the 11th century, each climbing to a mosque-watchtower, ringed by palm groves and fed by an ingenious foggara water system. Over three days you explore the market-town of Ghardaïa and the holy walled village of Beni Isguen, see the eco-town of Tafilelt and the palm oases, and head out by 4×4 for dinner under the desert stars. It is living UNESCO heritage, not a museum.

whyDifferent.d: The M'Zab's medieval towns are inhabited and used exactly as they were built.
The holy walled town is visited with a local guide and its own customs — rare access.
A 4×4 evening toward El Guerrara and dinner under the stars.
See the ancestral foggara channels that made oasis life possible.

tours.overview: Timimoun, the 'Red Oasis', is the heart of the Gourara — a Saharan world of ochre ksour, vast palm groves and the ingenious foggara channels that carry water for miles underground. tours.summary: Three days through Algeria's finest Roman heritage — the seaside ruins of Tipaza and Cherchell, the hillside city of Djémila, and the grid-planned streets of Timgad.
tours.hook: Three days, three of the greatest Roman cities on Earth — by the sea at Tipaza, on the hillside at Djémila, and across the grid of Timgad.
tours.overview: Algeria holds some of the best-preserved Roman cities anywhere, and this journey strings together the finest. You begin on the coast at Tipaza, where temples and bathhouses meet the Mediterranean, and at Caesarea (Cherchell) with its museum of statuary and mosaics. You cross to Djémila, draped over its hillside with colonnaded streets, monumental gateways and mosaic floors, and finish at Timgad — the textbook grid city Trajan founded for his veterans, with its theatre, forum and famous library. Three UNESCO-calibre sites, almost without crowds.

itinerary.body: Travel to Batna and the UNESCO Roman city of Timgad, with local heritage; overnight in Batna.

itinerary.title: Journey to Ghardaïa
itinerary.body: Travel south to the M'Zab Valley and check in at a traditional guesthouse, with a free evening.

itinerary.title: Ghardaïa cultural tour
itinerary.body: The villages of El Atteuf, Beni Isguen and Melika, their mosques and architecture, the souks and a lunch with a local family.

itinerary.title: Return to Algiers
itinerary.body: Travel back to Algiers, with the Hamma botanical garden, the Bardo Museum and Notre-Dame d'Afrique.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Breakfast and transfer to the airport.

includes: Private local guide at major sites
All meals during the desert excursion
Desert activities: quad biking, camel riding, sandboarding
excludes: Lunch and dinner on other days
